note: Evidence is import-side only. The 433 customs records are the company's purchases of carton-printing/die-cutting machinery and spares from Chinese and Taiwanese suppliers (HS 84419000, 84439100, 84669390) — this proves the company operates a packaging-converting plant, not that it ships goods out. The single export-side signal is the buyer row 'BHS CORRUGATED MALAYSIA Sdn. Bhd.' with count 4, which is a counterparty listing without a dated shipment line, so export status is 'declared_only', not confirmed. Declared HS codes 392010 and 732393 (plastic film / stainless steel hollow ware) do not match any observed record; the observed trade is packaging machinery parts, so the HS field should be treated as unverified and corrected to the actual traded codes per project rule 3. No revenue or export-volume figure is public in the sources reached — left null, not estimated. No evidence of non-existence, liquidation or insolvency was found, so no rejection basis.
